Every assurance statement in this repository reduces to per-clause tuples with named boundaries, and every requirement reads either SHIPPED with a cited symbol and test or NOT STARTED with a concrete named blocker — with nothing in between, permanently.

```day-telos
{"witnesses":["status-table","upstream-pin"]}
```

Held under pressure, which is the only way to assess it. Four claims inherited from the scaffold were found false by running the code rather than re-reading it: the unsafe count, the privilege field, T0 requiring no language work, and ==> being syntax. Two of those I introduced myself while correcting the others. Each was corrected in place with the error left visible. The roadmap still reads SHIPPED or NOT STARTED with no third category, and the two things this pass did not achieve — a verified payload, and reproducibility without the container — are stated in the same register as the successes.
